$comment: Curated lua-filter catalogue for the Enhancing Export store. See README.md in this folder for the entry schema. Every entry here is a filter that the pandoc-ext organisation has NOT re-published, so this catalogue and the pandoc-ext one never offer the same filter twice.

filters.description: Turns structured author and affiliation metadata into formatted blocks at the top of the document.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Writes the bibliography entries the document actually cites out to a .bib file.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Looks up the DOIs cited in the document and adds the matching entries to the bibliography.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Indents the first line of each paragraph, leaving the ones that open a section alone.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Fills a fenced code block with the contents of a file on disk, optionally a range of its lines.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Stops LaTeX breaking hyphenated words at the hyphen when it sets a line.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Renders embedded LilyPond music notation to images and puts them in the document.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Converts TeX math to SVG with MathJax, so formulas need no math support in the reader.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Support for the mhchem syntax for chemical equations and isotopes.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Sets code blocks in LaTeX with the minted package instead of the default verbatim.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Drops the parts of a document that are marked as not meant for the format being written.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Replaces plain quotation marks with the ones the document's language actually uses.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Passes code block attributes through to reveal.js, so a slide can step through its own code.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Normalises author and affiliation metadata into the shape scholarly templates expect.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Writes the document as a letter using the KOMA-Script scrlttr2 class.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Gives a figure a short caption for the list of figures, separate from the one under it.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Writes out the words of a document, so a spell checker reads the prose and not the markup.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Gives a table a short caption for the list of tables, separate from the one above it.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Accepts or rejects the tracked changes carried in a Word document.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters

filters.description: Counts the words of a document as pandoc reads it, rather than as the file spells it.
filters.author: pandoc/lua-filters
